Frequently Asked Questions about AA1Car website
NOTE: AA1Car.com has been on the internet since June 2003! That's almost FOREVER in internet time!
IS THIS AN AUTHORITATIVE WEBSITE? CAN I TRUST THE INFORMATION ON AA1CAR AS BEING ACCURATE AND UNBIASED?
Yes! All of the content on this website has been written by Larry Carley, a nationally known automotive technical writer, editor and author with over 40 years of experience in the automotive aftermarket. For more information about Larry, Click Here.
This website is supported by advertising, but none of the technical content has been written for or by any advertisers, or to promote anybody's products.
WHAT IS THE PURPOSE OF THE AA1CAR AUTOMOTIVE WEBSITE?
To provide helpful automotive diagnosis and repair information to any one who needs it -- for FREE! (See Disclaimer for details).
Our mission is to provide free, non-biased, technically accurate training and auto repair diagnosis help for motorists, do-it-yourselfers and automotive technicians.
AA1Car is NOT an online auto repair manual. Nor do we offer detailed diagnostic or repair procedures for your specific car. Rather, we try to provide basic information that can be applied to a wide variety of different years, makes and models of vehicles.
CAN I LINK TO ARTICLES ON THE AA1CAR WEBSITE?
You may link to the AA1Car.com main page, any of the AA1Car.com topic menu pages, or any of the individual article pages on this website.
You may NOT, however, capture articles or other content from the AA1Car website for use on another website, blog, online forum or social media account in part or in whole.
The content of AA1Car is protected by U.S Copyright law. You may NOT reproduce, reprint or electronically duplicate any content from this website for use elsewhere including personal or commercial websites, blogs, RSS feeds or other electronic media. Search engines make it very easy to find content that has been "borrowed" and reposted on other websites.
You can save or print pages for your own personal use. You may also quote material (with attribution) or use brief excerpts (no more than 1 or 2 paragraphs) in an automotive forum, Blog, email or other electronic communications. Please attribute the source to www.AA1Car.com, and/or add a link so that others may find the original source.
WILL YOU ADD MY LINK TO THE AA1CAR WEBSITE, OR TRADE LINKS?
If you have an automotive-related website (parts, accessories, tools, manuals, services, car care products, or anything else that is strictly automotive related), go to the LINKS page, click on a topic and find a sub-category where you think your link would best be placed. Then email me your link request with your site name and URL address.
NOTE: AA1Car is NOT trading links with any non-automotive websites. Don't waste your time or mine asking for a link unless your website is automotive.
Sorry, but we do NOT believe in THREE-WAY LINK EXCHANGES to boost page rank. Yes, we know that three-way link exchanges are a popular device for tricking search engines into thinking you have lots of inbound links (without the penalty of any outbound links). But we see this as a bogus way of gaining page rank and want no part of it. What good is a three-way return link on some bogus website or webpage that gets no traffic? Such pages are created solely for the purpose of fooling Google.
If a website is credible and worth linking to, we will add a link to it on an appropriate page on the AA1Car.com website. And we will NOT drop the link if the website does not link back to us. A good link is a good link. We don't require payback (though we do appreciate it). We want CREDIBILITY!
CAN I ADVERTISE ON THE AA1CAR WEBSITE?
Yes, if you have an automotive-related product or service you wish to advertise. We welcome banner ads and display ads. CLICK HERE for further details.
